flags.title: Empty hubs are not empty fixture lists
flags.detail: The main page and 13 hubs rendered ‘No tips found’; Motor Racing and Rugby League rendered no tournament tips/matches. This is capture-time OLBG interface state, not official confirmation of absent or completed fixtures.

flags.title: Expired OLBG samples cannot release picks
flags.detail: All 11 sampled event pages showed Expired on every displayed selection. Upcoming official fixtures do not reopen those listings, so no current OLBG market or publishable High pick is claimed.

flags.title: OLBG popularity is not a probability
flags.detail: Malformed ‘Most Popular Tip’ percentages and detailed tip counts were excluded from every calculation. Community selections are not calibrated probabilities or official availability evidence.

flags.title: Per-URL retrieval timestamps were not exposed
flags.detail: All source records carry registration time 2026-10-23T21:36:17Z; this is not represented as the exact network retrieval time or publisher update time. Source-provided update stamps are preserved separately in takeaways.

flags.title: Historical desk claims were not recycled
flags.detail: Earlier desk probabilities, fixtures, predictions and claimed pick counts were not accepted as fresh evidence. Historical URLs were used only as leads for new OLBG and official reads.

flags.title: Canonical root describes an older brief
flags.detail: The repository root still describes a 22 October, 17-sport release. This isolated desk covers exactly the current 15-sport brief; Australian Rules and eSports are excluded.

flags.title: Coordination board requires targeted maintenance
flags.detail: COORDINATION.md contains duplicated numbering and stale status rows. This session used an append-only claim and does not infer ownership from stale ‘in progress’ text.

flags.title: NBA report discovery required the official portal
flags.detail: A guessed 6:00 PM PDF returned AccessDenied. The official injury-report portal was then read and its actual latest captured link, 5:15 PM, supplied the team statuses.

flags.title: Player endpoints were not substituted for team statistics
flags.detail: NHL club-stats responses contained player statistics, not team standings. They were excluded; NHL's official standings table supplies every numerical hockey input.

flags.title: PDC consent wall limited direct extraction
flags.detail: The direct PDC article returned consent text. The official-domain search result supplied the article's fixture, session and recent-result text; that method is labeled rather than presented as a clean direct-page parse.
